rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for keeping an eye on and supervising people or activities.

example.english: Can you oversee the kids for me while I go buy a drink?
example.traditional: 你幫我睇住班細路，我去買杯飲品。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 baan1 sai3 lou6 ngo5 heoi3 maai5 bui1 jam2 ban2

rows.note: Use this when overseeing means being responsible for running or managing a team, department, or operation.

example.english: I oversee the entire customer service department now.
example.traditional: 我而家管理成個客服部門。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 gun2 lei5 seng4 go3 haak3 fuk6 bou6 mun4

rows.note: Use this for official or formal supervision, especially checking that work or spending is properly carried out.

example.english: The audit committee has a duty to oversee the use of the construction funds.
example.traditional: 審計委員會有責任監督工程款項嘅使用。
example.jyutping: sam2 gai3 wai2 jyun4 wui2 jau5 zaak3 jam6 gaam1 duk1 gung1 cing4 fun2 hong6 ge3 sai2 jung6
